name: Sozai Search MCP
summary: MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients: search an index of 36,287 free 3D assets (Poly Haven, ambientCG, Kenney, Quaternius, plus Quixel Megascans Fab listings) by keywords or meaning, preview them, and download GLB/PBR/HDRI files at real-world scale in metres. No GPU, API key or account. The tool hosts no files; downloads come from the official libraries.

access.notes: Code MIT. Assets keep own licences (mostly CC0). 22,696 of 36,287 index rows are Megascans (Fab link only; Epic account, no redistribution). Kenney/Quaternius need local kit-zip ingest. Direct fetch: Poly Haven + ambientCG. Brand/logo not MIT.

procedure: Install uv, then in your project register the server: claude mcp add sozai -s project -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/sozai-search-mcp sozai (Codex/Cursor take the same uvx command).
Start a new session and search for e.g. "wooden crate"; the first search downloads the published data index (~13.4 MB zip, 36,287 records).
Use fetch_asset to download from Poly Haven or ambientCG into a folder you name. For Kenney or Quaternius, download the official kit zip first and run sozai ingest.
Optional: run sozai semantic-setup (~350 MB EmbeddingGemma 2) for meaning search in any language.

stats.size: repo zip ~2.6 MB; data zip 13.4 MB

verdict.why: First-party launch (117 likes, 128 bookmarks). MIT license read. Data zip verified: 36,287 records and NOTICE.txt. Direct downloads are Poly Haven/ambientCG; Megascans are Fab links only and kits need ingest. 3 GitHub stars because the repo is hours old; X traction is the proof.
